Field guide

Your own little chaos.

Spawn objects, build contraptions, and explore how they react. Every experiment starts with a little curiosity.

Move & build

Q / E Spawn the chosen object facing left / right

A / D Rotate what you hold or select — it keeps the angle. While holding, Q / E rotate too

F Activate the object under the cursor

S Detail view of the object under the cursor

R Turn the ragdoll (or flip the object) under the cursor

Z Undo the last spawn

⌫ Delete the selected object

Tools

1 Grab · 2 Rope · 3 Freeze

4 Shoot · 5 Fire · 6 Shock

7 Explosion · 8 Heal

9 Revive a dead or collapsed ragdoll

\ Partial revive: alive again, wounds and all

- Regrow missing limbs · = Reattach a severed limb

[ Graft any loose limb onto any body · ] Dismember

0 Delete objects

Esc Back to the grab cursor · Space Pause · G Slow motion · Tab Hide the interface · ↑↓←→ Pan (Shift = faster)
Scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan. Hold Shift with A / D to rotate faster. Keys follow People Playground's defaults.
